mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptNicknameSequence */ TB_NKSEQX SET LAST_NUMB = LAST_NUMB + 1 , UPDT_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE NICK_TEXT = #{nickText} AND ISSU_YEAM = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMM') AND LAST_NUMB < #{maxSequence}
mapper.select: SELECT /* getNicknameSequenceDtl */ N.NICK_TEXT , N.ISSU_YEAM , N.LAST_NUMB , N.REGI_DATE , N.UPDT_DATE FROM TB_NKSEQX N WHERE N.NICK_TEXT = #{nickText} AND N.ISSU_YEAM = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMM')
